title_en: Chinese TV Dramas (19/20): Documentaries, Majestic Landscapes and Seas of Clouds
note_en: 即使……也…… means "even if ...": 让观众即使不出门也能感受大自然的魅力 "let viewers feel the magic of nature even without leaving home." English needs only "even if" or "even without," but Chinese must add 也 before the verb of the main clause (也能感受), and the 即使 clause always comes first.
